name: silvershop-suite/newsletter
description: Newsletter signup, marketing consent, double opt-in and queued ESP synchronisation for SilverShop. Works on any SilverStripe 6 site; checkout and order integration light up when silvershop/core is present.

suggest.silvershop/core: Enables the checkout opt-in checkbox, the account email-preferences section and ecommerce order sync; the module is inert on those surfaces without it.
suggest.silvershop-suite/store-profile: Uses the central shop name and contact email as the sender of confirmation / double-opt-in emails.
suggest.silverstripe/spamprotection: Protects the public signup form with the site's configured spam protector.
suggest.tractorcow/silverstripe-fluent: Stores the subscriber's locale and keeps per-locale lists in sync with the ESP.
